topic: Enhancement systems, electric filing, wraps, resins, dips, gels, and nail art
author: codex-authoring-run-2026-08-13-enhancements-02

why: Oil on the nail plate can block an enhancement from bonding. Primer is most useful on oily nails because it helps the product hold.
甲板上的油分会阻碍人工甲产品黏附。油性指甲最需要 primer（底剂），因为它能帮助产品黏牢。
lock: oily nail plate = primer may improve the bond.
油性甲板 = primer 可帮助黏附。
refs: Nail Product Chemistry - Primers

why: Overfiling removes too many nail-plate layers. Porous means having more tiny openings, so the thinned nail absorbs liquids more easily and becomes weak.
过度修锉会去掉太多甲板层。porous 表示有更多微小孔隙，因此变薄的指甲更容易吸收液体，也更脆弱。
lock: overfiling = thin, weak nail with more tiny openings.
过度修锉 = 指甲变薄、变弱、孔隙增多。
refs: Nail Product Chemistry - Dangers of Over-Filing

why: Scrubbing removes oil, dust, and germs from the nail plate. Product can bond more evenly when nothing is trapped underneath it.
刷洗能去掉甲板上的油、粉尘和细菌。下面没有残留物时，产品能更均匀地黏附。
lock: before enhancement product: scrub the nail clean.
涂人工甲产品前：刷洗甲面。
refs: Nail Product Chemistry - Preparing for Adhesion

why: Scope of practice sets the services a license holder may legally perform. It protects clients by keeping workers within their training and state rules.
scope of practice（执业范围）规定持证人员可以合法提供哪些服务，让工作人员只在培训和州规定范围内操作。
lock: scope of practice = services legally allowed.
scope of practice = 法律允许的服务范围。
refs: The Nail Profession - Scope of Practice

why: Fans and open windows move contaminated air around but may not remove it. A proper air system captures dust and vapor near their source.
风扇和开窗只是移动受污染空气，不一定把它排走。正确的空气系统会在粉尘和蒸气产生处附近捕捉并排出。
lock: salon air control = capture pollution at its source.
沙龙空气控制 = 在污染源附近捕捉。
refs: Nail Product Chemistry - Salon Air Quality

why: An N95 mask filters very small airborne dust when it fits the face correctly. A loose paper mask leaves gaps around the edges.
N95 口罩贴合面部时能过滤很小的空气粉尘。宽松的普通纸口罩边缘会留下空隙。
lock: nail dust mask = well-fitted N95.
美甲粉尘口罩 = 贴合良好的 N95。
refs: Nail Product Chemistry - Dust Masks

why: Torque is the turning force of an electric file. Strong torque helps the bit keep moving when light working pressure is applied.
torque（扭矩）是电动磨甲机的转动力。扭矩足够时，轻微施压工作也能保持磨头转动。
lock: torque = turning force under pressure.
torque = 受压时的转动力。
refs: Electric Filing - Machine Power and Torque

why: A wobbling bit sends repeated uneven movement into the hand and arm. Over time, that strain can injure muscles, tendons, or nerves.
晃动的磨头会把反复而不均匀的震动传到手和手臂。长期下来可能损伤肌肉、肌腱或神经。
lock: wobbling bit = repeated strain injury risk.
磨头晃动 = 反复劳损风险。
refs: Electric Filing - Ergonomics and Bit Balance

why: A pencil grip gives fine control without squeezing the handpiece tightly. It also keeps the wrist in a more natural working position.
像握铅笔一样握手柄，可精细控制而不必用力抓紧，也让手腕保持更自然的工作姿势。
lock: handpiece grip = relaxed pencil hold.
手柄握法 = 放松的握笔姿势。
refs: Electric Filing - Holding the Handpiece

why: Heavy pressure lets one part of the bit cut too deeply into the enhancement or nail. Light pressure and constant movement prevent ring-shaped grooves.
压力过大会让磨头某处切得太深。轻压并持续移动，可防止磨出环形沟槽。
lock: avoid fire rings: light pressure and steady movement.
避免火圈：轻压并持续移动。
refs: Electric Filing - Avoiding Rings of Fire

why: Controlled file strokes remove product evenly. Good file skill prevents low spots, high spots, and an uneven finished surface.
稳定控制甲锉动作能均匀去除产品。良好的修锉技术可防止高低不平的完成表面。
lock: controlled filing = even surface.
稳定修锉 = 表面均匀。
refs: Electric Filing - Finish Filing

why: A tip adds a ready-made extension piece. A form sits under the free edge so product can be shaped into an extension.
tip（甲片）直接增加预制延长部分；form（纸托）放在游离缘下，让产品在上面塑造成延长甲。
lock: extension methods = tip or form.
延长甲方法 = 甲片或纸托。
refs: Nail Extensions - Tips and Forms

why: A nail form fits under the free edge and temporarily supports wet product. After the product hardens, the form is removed.
nail form（纸托）放在游离缘下，暂时支撑未硬化产品。产品硬化后再取下纸托。
lock: form = temporary guide under the free edge.
form = 游离缘下的临时塑形支撑。
refs: Nail Forms - Purpose and Fit

why: A fine buffer smooths small adhesive remains without taking off too much natural nail. Heavy filing can thin and damage the plate.
细砂抛光锉能磨平少量残胶，又不会去掉太多天然甲板。用力粗锉会使甲板变薄受损。
lock: tip removal residue = gentle fine buffer.
卸甲片后的残胶 = 轻柔使用细砂抛光锉。
refs: Nail Tips - Removal

why: Matching the middle, index, and ring nail lengths creates visual balance across the hand. The thumb and little finger are adjusted to fit their size.
中指、食指和无名指长度一致，可让整只手看起来平衡。拇指和小指则按各自大小调整。
lock: index, middle, ring = matching extension length.
食指、中指、无名指 = 延长长度一致。
refs: Nail Tips - Length and Shape

why: Nail resin can repair, reinforce, or secure wrap fabric. A resin layer alone is not the normal method for building a permanent long extension.
美甲树脂可用于修补、加固或固定包裹材料。单独使用树脂层并不是制作永久长延长甲的正常方法。
lock: resin = repair and reinforcement, not permanent extension alone.
树脂 = 修补和加固，不单独制作永久延长甲。
refs: Nail Wraps and Resins - Uses

why: Thin resin spreads easily and exposes more material to moisture, so it hardens faster. Thick resin moves slowly and generally needs more curing time.
稀树脂容易铺开，更多材料接触水分，因此硬化较快。稠树脂流动慢，通常需要更长固化时间。
lock: thin resin = faster cure; thick resin = slower cure.
稀树脂 = 固化较快；稠树脂 = 固化较慢。
refs: Nail Wraps and Resins - Viscosity and Cure

why: A nail wrap places fabric over the nail or around a tip, then secures it with resin. The fabric adds support to a weak or repaired area.
nail wrap（指甲包裹）把纤维材料铺在指甲或甲片周围，再用树脂固定。纤维能支撑薄弱或修补部位。
lock: nail wrap = fabric plus resin support.
nail wrap = 纤维材料加树脂支撑。
refs: Nail Wraps - Definition and Uses

why: A dip system builds an acrylic overlay while colored powder supplies the color. This combines structure and nail color in the same service.
dip system（蘸粉系统）用粉末建立丙烯酸覆盖层，同时由有色粉末提供颜色，把结构和甲色合在一次服务中。
lock: dip system = overlay plus color together.
dip system = 覆盖加颜色一次完成。
refs: Dip Systems - Features

why: A medium bead has enough liquid to wet the powder without running. It stays workable and holds its shape during application.
中等湿度的小球有足够液体润湿粉末，又不会流动，涂布时容易操作并能保持形状。
lock: ideal working bead = medium, not wet or dry.
理想操作小球 = 中等，不太湿也不太干。
refs: Monomer Liquid and Polymer Powder - Mix Ratio

why: A wet bead contains more monomer than powder, so it looks shiny and spreads easily. The stated wet ratio is two liquid parts to one powder part.
湿小球含有较多单体液，因此表面发亮并容易流动。这里的湿比例是两份液体配一份粉末。
lock: wet bead = 2 liquid to 1 powder.
湿小球 = 2 份液体配 1 份粉末。
refs: Monomer Liquid and Polymer Powder - Mix Ratio

why: A fine-grit buffer removes very small scratches left after shaping. Coarser grit would create new deep scratches instead of refining the finish.
细砂抛光锉能去掉塑形后留下的细小划痕。粗砂会产生新的深划痕，不能完成细致表面。
lock: finish filing and buffing = fine grit.
完成修锉和抛光 = 细砂。
refs: Electric Filing - Finish Filing and Buffing

why: Hard gel does not dissolve in acetone. It must be carefully reduced with a file, leaving the natural nail protected underneath.
hard gel（硬胶）不能被丙酮溶解，必须用甲锉小心磨除，同时保护下面的天然指甲。
lock: hard gel removal = file, not soak.
硬胶卸除 = 修锉，不浸泡。
refs: UV and LED Gels - Hard Gel Removal

why: Adhesion means how well two surfaces hold together. Bonding gel creates a connecting layer between the prepared nail plate and later gel layers.
adhesion（黏附）表示两个表面结合得多牢。粘接胶在处理好的甲板和后续凝胶层之间形成连接层。
lock: bonding gel = helps gel hold to the nail plate.
粘接胶 = 帮助凝胶黏住甲板。
refs: UV and LED Gels - Bonding Gels

why: Polymer gel combines polymer powder with a hard-gel product. The mixture gives the technician a thicker material for building structure.
polymer gel（聚合物凝胶）把聚合物粉末与硬胶结合，形成较稠的材料，用于建立结构。
lock: polymer gel = polymer powder plus hard gel.
polymer gel = 聚合物粉末加硬胶。
refs: UV and LED Gels - Polymer Gels

why: UV and LED gel stays workable until matching light starts its hardening reaction. Each applied layer therefore needs its own complete light cure.
UV 和 LED 凝胶会保持可操作状态，直到匹配灯光启动硬化反应。因此每一层涂布后都要单独完整固化。
lock: gel application = cure every layer with matching light.
凝胶涂布 = 每层都用匹配灯光固化。
refs: UV and LED Gels - Light Curing

why: Nail art gives salons more designs and add-on services to sell. More service choices can raise the amount earned from each appointment.
美甲艺术让沙龙可以销售更多设计和附加服务。服务选择增加后，每次预约的收入也可能提高。
lock: more nail-art services = more revenue opportunities.
更多美甲艺术服务 = 更多收入机会。
refs: Nail Art - Industry Impact

why: Marbleizing moves two or more wet colors into curved lines before they set. The mixed movement creates a stone-like swirled pattern.
marbleizing（大理石纹）在颜色未干前把两种或更多颜色拉成弯曲线条，形成像石纹一样的旋涡图案。
lock: marbleizing = swirls made from wet colors.
marbleizing = 湿颜色形成的旋涡纹。
refs: Nail Art - Marbleizing

why: A smooth bead has an even liquid-to-powder mix with no dry lumps. That consistency spreads evenly and creates a cleaner design.
表面平滑的小球具有均匀液粉比例，没有干粉块，因此铺展均匀，也能做出更整洁的图案。
lock: good acrylic art bead = smooth and evenly mixed.
好的丙烯酸彩绘小球 = 平滑、混合均匀。
refs: Nail Art - Monomer Liquid and Polymer Powder Art

notes: All candidates remain unreviewed. One context-dependent machine-control item was quarantined.
